variants.name: Sigh
variants.desc: Eyes droop low, the body sinks and lets out slow sighs.

variants.name: Rain cloud
variants.desc: A little grey cloud parks overhead and drizzles on it.

variants.name: Deflate
variants.desc: Slowly loses air and flattens out, then barely recovers.

variants.name: Teardrop
variants.desc: A single tear wells up, rolls down and drops off.

variants.name: Head shake
variants.desc: Eyes shut, it shakes its head slowly. No luck.
